units: Bets. 40ᵃ משום ס׳ דמשכא on account of the adhesion of the skin (because the hide is hard to flay unless the animal is watered before slaughtering).—[In ritual: ס׳ an adhesion of lobes of the lungs to each other or to the chest.]
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 30a:13">Ab. Zar. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ דגברא נקיטה</he> she is supposed to have adopted her husband’s habits.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 51b:5">Snh. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ בעלמא נקט</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) he merely used the customary phraseology.

senses.gloss: (cmp. b. h. שָׂרִיג) branch, scion of a figtree.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:6">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> (prov.) <he>ס׳ דאקים תאינתא</he> a scion which confirms (the reputation of) the fig tree, i.e. a good son of a good father; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 134">Yalk. Sam. 134</cite> <he>בִּרְכָּא תניתא</he> (some ed. <cite ref="K01194"><he>כרכה</he></cite>), prob. to be read: <he>ברכא דמקים תינתא</he>).—[<he>סרכי</he>, <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 116">Yalk. Gen. 116</cite>, v. <cite ref="U01993"><he>שְׂרָכָא</he></cite>].
